notes: The 1974 volume of the Recreation and Park Commission. Curated: architects' agreements, dedications, the Palace of Fine Arts theater lobby.

findings.description: The Alice Eastwood Garden in the Strybing Arboretum, given by the San Francisco Garden Club, was dedicated on May 7, as a commissioner reported to the Recreation and Park Commission.

findings.address_as_written: New animal hospital, San Francisco Zoo
findings.description: The zoo's new animal hospital was formally dedicated just before the Recreation and Park Commission's meeting; the zoo's veterinarian, Dr. Mottram, had played a major part in its design.

findings.address_as_written: Palace of Fine Arts - Expansion of Theater Facilities
findings.description: Hans U. Gerson, for the Palace of Fine Arts League, showed the Recreation and Park Commission his plans, already passed by the Art Commission, to enlarge the Palace of Fine Arts theater lobby, separating the concession area from the foyer and adding a proper box office, paid for by a $90,000 gift from Walter Johnson.

findings.description: The Recreation and Park Commission approved an agreement of up to $12,000 with Michael Painter and Associates, landscape architects, to design and supervise the rehabilitation of the Children's Playground in Golden Gate Park, made possible by gifts including one from an anonymous donor.
